notes_for_editor: Main issue is status. The FFLA Minnesota list (firelookout.org/lookouts/us/mn/) marks Agassiz HQ Tower Gone at the record's coordinates; the refuge visit page describes a climbable 100-foot tower near headquarters; the photo caption says 99 feet. Neither is dated. The refuge gives 100 ft and 99 ft; height_m left out. Wikidata Q107541850 gives 48 deg 17 min 57 sec N, 95 deg 59 min 1 sec W, about 230 m from the record point, and cites a minnesotafiretower.blogspot.com post that returned HTTP 404 in our fetch. A separate Agassiz Pool tower (48.33862, -95.92350) is also marked gone in the FFLA list and is kept separate. The 2005 FFLA report has a typo ('5ht'); we assume the 2005 Agassiz Refuge Fire Tower is this tower but the report does not say where it stands. A web search snippet mentions a 2008 refuge announcement about a DNR deer testing station at the tower and a 2025 hunting map legend; those were not read as pages and are not used. Suggested check: refuge headquarters (phone from the search snippet was not verified, so not repeated here) or a dated site visit by the owner.
